get.description: WebSocket. Each text frame is a ProgressEvent JSON; the server closes after the job reaches done, failed or fulfilled. Browsers cannot send headers on a WebSocket, so the staff token goes in the `token` query parameter. Close code 4401 means no valid token, 4404 unknown job.
